notes.title: 1 week since release! Thank you + what's next!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Researchers![/h2]

It's been about 1 week since the launch of Research Story 1.0! A big thank you to everyone who played the game. I'm happy to hear that many of you are enjoying it! 💗

I've been doing some post-release patches and adjustments based on feedback. I've also been reading your comments and watching streams and videos of the game. I'll be taking all these into consideration when moving forward with Research Story!

[h2][b]Short-term plans (v1.1)[/b][/h2]
[h3][u]Techincal upgrade[/u][/h3]
I've started working on a technical upgrade for the game (upgrading the game engine). This takes time and may not translate into obvious content/features, but should further improve the stability of the game and allow me to introduce certain features such as an option for borderless fullscreen.

[h3][u]✨Improving experience of learning the game[/u][/h3]
My priority for v1.1 is to improve the experience of the early-game where players are learning the ropes. That includes:
- Making some quests clearer (more step-by-step), such as the creature research quest.
- Having gameplay hints that appear at the daily summary page or loading screen, to remind or prompt players about certain mechanics.
- Improving Heart Event tracking within the game.

I'll also add some of the smaller player-requested features, such as indoor wallpaper/flooring.

[h2][b]Longer-term plans[/b][/h2]
[h3][u]Ports[/u][/h3]
As mentioned, I wanted to explore Mac, Linux, and console port possibilities.

[b]Linux port[/b]: I've received some advice from the community (Linux-players) regarding a Linux port: since Research Story is already playable on Linux via Proton, porting to Linux may not be the best use of my time. It may result in a poorer experience for Linux players if the port is not done properly and consistently. [b]As such, I'll be shelving this until further notice.[/b] [u]For Linux players, if you have trouble launching or playing the game, please reach out and I believe the community and I will be happy to help troubleshoot any issues.[/u]

[b]Mac and Switch Port:[/b] As for Mac and console ports, I'll share more when I make progress. A Switch port that many players are asking about is firstly dependent on whether I'm able to get access to the platform, and right now I don't have an answer for that.

[h3][u]💬Languages[/u][/h3]
We'd love to add more languages and are looking into how best we can go about doing so.

[h3][u]✨v1.2 onwards[/u][/h3]
While there aren't any fixed plans yet, I've heard your requests: even more romanceables, more non-romanceable stories, more post-marriage content, and just additional features and content in general. These are larger changes that I'll consider as the game and community continue to grow.

[h2][b]Community Highlights[/b][/h2]
Once again, thank you for all the support you've shown the game! Here's a nice condensed video from one of our community members that introduces the research mechanic in the game. It also includes some tips for new players:
[previewyoutube=Lb_sT9XN9tc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Ways to support the game[/b][/h2]
If you'd like to further support the game, you can:
[list]
[*] Write a review for the game on Steam.
[*] Share about the game with your favourite content creators.
[*] Share any bug reports and feedback you have for the game. I read most, if not all comments and they all help me know what players want the most.
[/list]

Happy researching! 📖✨
Miki

notes.title: Research Story 1.0 Out Now! 📖✨
notes.content:
[h2]Research Story 1.0 is Out Now![/h2]
Hi Researchers! After about 2.5 years in Early Access, I'm so happy to share that the game is now complete and ready for full release! Thank you to everyone who has helped during the 1.0 public beta, and played during EA! 💗

[previewyoutube=0RwPrAlJjOE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Completed Story and 1.0 Update Summary[/h2]
Here are the key things added in this 1.0 update:
[h3]📖Epilogue, conclusion, and end-credits[/h3]
The game now has a 'proper' ending that includes a better conclusion to tie up the story and lead to the end-credits. But don't worry, you can still play after that and there's even end-game content to discover!
[h3]💍Proposal and Marriage[/h3]
You'll be able to marry one of the 10 marriage candidates! Prior to marriage, each NPC has either a Proposal (player-initiated) or Reverse-Proposal (NPC-initiated) Event specific and unique to each NPC.
[h3]🔍Legendary Research[/h3]
This is part of the end-game content, where unique researchables can be found and researched.
[h3]✨Lots of QOL adjustments[/h3]
Added UI elements such as a Collections tab, improved Sesame's Fishing Map, move-able and replaceable chests, festival/hangout reminders and more.

Full Update Notes found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1629830/view/515216044012341110?l=english]here[/url].

[h2]Guides and Resources[/h2]
We have a [url=https://researchstory.fandom.com/wiki/Research_Story_Wiki]community wiki[/url] and a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1629830/guides/]several guides[/url] on Steam. You can also always reach out on the Steam forums or our lovely Discord and we're always happy to help!

[h2]Launch Discount and Pricing Update[/h2]
We're launching with a [b]20% launch discount that will last for 1 week[/b]! 30 days after the discount ends, we plan to raise the base price of the game slightly to USD14.99, which will be the full price of the 1.0.

Our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2483750/Research_Story_Soundtrack/]Research Story Soundtrack[/url] is also updated with all 40 OSTs made for the game.

[h2]Some charts/data[/h2]
Lots of content and features have been added to the game over the 2.5 years in Early Access! Many of these were based on player feedback and suggestions. We've come a long way :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/4805d4d90f6a75f757bdc5f914eb0acf7901746e.png[/img]

Word count - I thought it would be interesting to share that we have ~90,000 words in Research Story 1.0! Menu, item descriptions, letters, and narrative strings etc. take up about 30,000 words while the other 60,000 words are NPC dialogues. That's a lot of words... NPC cutscenes and events always take longer than I expect to write and add, and now I know why haha. I wonder which NPC has the most to say?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/9b385deadce9a4af25c8dae7061231bce4d7ba20.png[/img]

[h2]What's next for Research Story[/h2]
Phew! It's been over 5 years since I started working full-time on this game, and how time flies. This project is my darling and I want the best for it! While it's story-complete with all major features included, I know that more can always be added to a game like Research Story.

I plan to start looking into mac and linux ports, and possibly console ports - these are all new to me so it's hard to estimate how long they'd take. At the same time, I'll look into some of the suggestions from players I didn't manage to include for the 1.0, and think about what more we can add to the game. So if you have any wishes, let me know since your requests tell me what players want! :)

Now, go have fun researching! 💗
- Miki

notes.title: Research Story v1.0 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Key Features & Content[/h2]
[h3]Proposals/Reverse-proposals[/h3]
- All 10 romanceables have either a proposal or reverse-proposal event.
- Added 10 unique Keepsakes that can be obtained during the proposal events.
- Added Ruby Ring
Wedding
- Added Wedding Day scheduling (Choose Date and Decor)
- Added Wedding Day cutscene
- Added 3 Wedding Dresses and 3 Wedding Suits
[h3]Marriage[/h3]
- Spouse moves in after the Wedding, and their daily routines will be adjusted.
- Added Family Chest (Gold contribution from spouse).
- Added Show Affection option for spouses
- Added kissing sprite between player and romanceables.
- Added NPC dialogues for reacting to the player's marriage.
- Added mini cutscenes for player’s birthday and wedding anniversary after marriage.

[h3]Completion of Main Story[/h3]
- Added final Main Story Quest - Epilogue: Knowledge Prevails, along with the conclusion to the story in Shimmerbrook.
- Added Ending scene with closing credits, as well as post-credits dialogue and scenes.

[h3]End-game content (Major story and content spoilers!)[/h3]
These are unlocked after the Main Story is complete.
- Added [spoiler]statues that can give players instant/semi-permanent buffs[/spoiler].
- Added [spoiler]new teleport location: Site of Repose[/spoiler].
- Added 4 Legendary Research: Mana Flower, Geminix, Gold Fish, and Gem Fish
- Added Magic Fertiliser
- Added a new shop [spoiler]that will replace the reserved residential building after the Main Story is complete[/spoiler].
- New Vendor NPC: [spoiler]Hueon, who sells end-game decor (gold decor sets etc.) after Main Story is complete.[/spoiler]
-- Note: Vendor NPCs do not have Heart Event Cutscenes, but their dialogues will change based on Heart Level.

[h2]Other content[/h2]
[h3]NPCs[/h3]
- All NPCs now have a 'Favourite' creature (added for Lisa, Zuri, Niamh, Yun Xi, Zi, Greydohr, Alfie, and Layla).
- Added several NPC dialogue about others' loved gifts.
- Added Gnoel portrait, along with portraits of other supporting NPCs in cutscenes.
- Asking Kipp to tidy your porch now does something.
- [spoiler]Kyr's[/spoiler] routines updated.
- Added different poems for the Spring Poems Event in even years.
[h3]Locations[/h3]
- Added a kitchen in the back of the General Store.
- Added a room in the back of the Violet Archive.
[h3]Collections Tab[/h3]
- Added Collections Tab under 'Profile' that records Pristine Parchments, Cooking Recipes, Research Samples, and several other item types.
- In the Collections Tab, an icon indicates whether an item has been submitted to the Exhibition Area before.
-- Note: Cooking Recipes show if recipes have been cooked before. However, the number of times cooked has all been reset to 1 (even if it's cooked more than once during Early Access).
Secrets
- Added 5 Pristine Parchments and corresponding secrets
[h3]Items[/h3]
- Added Sky Beetle
- Added Birch decor set
- Added Gold decor set
Achievements
- Added 4 new Steam Achievements

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
[b]General[/b]
- Increased item magnetism speed.
- Increased placeable range before it's considered 'too far'.
- Reduced Shoulder Bag price (5500G -> 3500G).
- Adjusted some spawn bounding boxes in the Mines to prevent overlapping debris and plants.
- Adjusted some blocking bounding boxes to prevent building near the map entrances.
- Added a spring mushroom foraging spot at Luke's foraging spot.
[b]Plants/Trees[/b]
- Caffodil can now spawn in Town.
- Tapper produce time reduced: Birch (7 -> 6 days), Fir (4 -> 3 days)
[b]Mining[/b]
- Balancing rework for ore/gem spawn rates in the Mines, especially from floor 41 onwards.
[b]Fishing[/b]
- Researchable Fish now only bites if its research is in progress or completed. This prevents catching a fish while not in research and thus not progressing in the research task.
- From the Copper tier onwards, the player gains more control over the fishing minigame: right click to turn the fishing handle in the other direction.
[b]Crafting[/b]
- Reduced crafting cost of Iron Chest (5 iron bar -> 3 iron bars)
- Insects are now considered a "small material" in the Magic Forge.
- Adjusted crafting recipe for Porter Chest (Hard Stone Brick now required for crafting).
- Increased selling price for Hard Stone Brick (50G -> 160G).
- Reduced selling price for Porter Chests (2000G -> 550G).
[b]NPCs[/b]
- Increased "Daily Chat" Relationship Points from 30 to 35.
- Mail about Butterfly Brooch can now be gotten earlier, on 13 Summer instead of 20 Summer.
[b]Puzzles[/b]
- [Applies to new saves only] The Light Puzzle in the Woods Caves has one changed pedestal requirement: [spoiler]Blue Crayfish instead of Crayfish Claw[/spoiler].

[h2]Audio[/h2]
- Added 4 new OSTs: In Sickness and In Health, Dancing in the Rain, Uncovering History, and A Fresh Start
- Increased the volume of some existing soundtracks.
- Adjusted volume of some sound effects.
- Some ambient sounds (such as bird calls) are now correctly part of SFX volume instead of BGM volume settings.
- Added more SFX for Wardrobe UI.
[b]Audio Options[/b]
- Added Master Volume option
- Added Ambient Volume option

[h2]Controller adjustments and improvements[/h2]
[b]General[/b]
- Improved detection for chopping trees/stumps and refilling watering can.
- Adjusted some interactable detection: Paths, Fences, and Crafting Stations now must be in the player's facing grid to be interacted with.
- Added better support for fisher map UI in Sesame's home (you can now look through the fish).
[b]Toolwheel[/b]
- Adjusted and improved toolwheel interaction.
-- Tool wheel loops back when selecting with RT/LT
-- Adjustment to feel of the toolwheel.
-- Added Arrange Tools using controller.
-- Press B to unequip tool, which helps with some clunkiness where trying to unequip using Right Stick made it look like the tool could not be selected.

[h2]Other QOL adjustments and improvements[/h2]
[b]General[/b]
- Don't auto-hold items if picking one up with an empty slot.
- Improved placing Auto-tappers: hold and place multiple Auto-tappers smoothly.
- Reminders for key events such as Hangout Event/Festival/Tool upgrades now have a more obvious notification icon. Also added a SFX for them.
- If your tool upgrade is ready but Remus is not open that day (Wed/Sun), the "tool is ready reminder" will no longer show at the start of the day.
[b]Chests[/b]
- Equal- or higher- tiered chests can now replace existing placed chests. (Iron Chests/Powered Chests can replace placed Wood Chests; Powered chest can replace Iron Chests.)
- Move filled chests from one spot to another (in the same room) with the Move button in the Chest UI.
- The ‘Colours of Nature’ mail now gives you a Paintbrush (Pink), to introduce players to painting for chests (only applies if you have not received the mail yet).
Tutorials
- Added Friendship Tutorial
- Added a hint for where to submit fish research during the "Unidentified Fish Part" Quest.
- Tutorial for Crafting will now still show up even if you pressed the crafting tab before obtaining a crafting recipe.
[b]NPCs[/b]
- Shortened Rhea's introduction dialogue and made it more concise.
- Disable giving Butterfly Brooch to another NPC if on a hangout event with an NPC.
- Added a hangout event notification reminder 1 hour before hangout.
[b]Shops[/b]
- Click and hold to sell multiple items to the General Store.
- Theo's Wood Station now sells Food Cabinet.
- Stoneworks now sells Cooking Stove.
[b]Fishing[/b]
- Added Seasonality: "Any season while in the caves" icon in the Aquatic Creatures Journal.
- Equipped fishing bait type is now also visible on the bauble when fishing.
- Certain Fish Parts that require fishing in 2 different locations will only appear after the second location is unlocked.
- Improved Fishing Map in the Fisher's Hut:
-- Fish Map now shows more information about non-researchable fish: whether fish has been caught before and number caught.
-- Added seasonal hints about certain researchable fish.
[b]General UI[/b]
- [Visual] Mail and Noticeboard icons now bob a little.
- Added scrollable area for Mail UI.
- Updated letter sprites.
- Main Quests are now divided into Introductory/Regular. Introductory Main Quests are indicated with an icon.
- Daily Summary page will still show even if there is no specific progress for the day.
- Adjusted Note-type item use while in chest inventory: to be sorted like a regular item instead of being used.
- Show 'Added to Wardrobe' notification when adding equipment to wardrobe
- Adjusted watering can grid indicator visuals.
- Made Tabs in Creature Info UI more slightly obvious (selected tab is higher).
- Magnifying glass in the Inventory now shows a clear indication when hovering over a researchable item that has not been researched yet.
- Changed the term "Research Rank" to "Research Level".
[b]Misc[/b]
- Added a way for players to submit bug reports and their affected files more easily from the Start Menu.
- Added Petal Cat Games logo on startup

notes.content:

The public beta is now available! Players who have the game can opt in to access the 1.0 update early, and help us in this last stretch before the official launch!
[quote][u]Side note for content creators[/u]: I’ll drop you an email about this with more details by the end of this week! [h3]Important Notes ❗️[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Backups are highly recommended before you start on the beta version[/b]! The game will automatically create a backup of all saves when you launch it, but to be extra safe, please have a backup copy of your Research Story folder in case of any unforeseen circumstances. You don't need to do this if it's the first time you're launching the game:
[olist]
[*] Open Run app (Windows + R key) and copy [b]%LOCALAPPDATA%\ [/b] to the field. Press Ok.
[*] Find and copy+paste the [u]ResearchStory folder[/u] to a safe location, such as your Desktop.
[/olist]
[*] Any saves that are started or saved in the public beta build will be [b]incompatible with any earlier versions of the game[/b] (i.e. if you go back to the Early Access version, the save will become unstable).
[*] The saves will be [b]compatible with future versions of the game[/b] (i.e. You’ll get to continue these saves in the official 1.0 launch and beyond).
[*] This build has gone through some internal testing, but since it’s the first time we’re sharing it with a wider audience, [b]you may experience some new bugs / instability[/b]. Any and all reports would be very helpful and I’ll fix any major bugs as soon as possible!
[/list]
[h3]Some things to expect in the public beta 🔍[/h3]
[list]
[*]The public beta includes the full 1.0 content.
[*]There will be bugs, and things I've missed - I plan to use the remaining two weeks before official launch to polish and fix as much as possible!

4) In the same menu, go to Installed Files -> Verify integrity of game files to get the update immediately.

notes.title: ✨ Research Story 1.0 Release Date!✨
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Researchers![/h2]

[h2][b]Research Story 1.0 will be releasing on July 21, 2025[/b]![/h2]

View the annoucement trailer below:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0RwPrAlJjOE
[h2]Public Beta on July 7[/h2]
We're planning to make the [b]1.0 release update available in a public beta branch[/b] on [b]July 7[/b] for interested players, and use the final two weeks to catch and fix as many bugs as possible. Players who own the game will be able to opt in. More details will be shared when that happens!

[h2]Our Early Access journey[/h2]
Early Access launched on 21 Feb 2023, and it's been over 2 years since then. We've added so much to the game, much more than I first planned! Partly due to the expanded scope, development for Early Access took longer as well.

That said, with the story epilogue, marriage, and some end-game content as part of the 1.0 launch update, I believe Research Story is in a good place for full release and has plenty of content and fun for players to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/4805d4d90f6a75f757bdc5f914eb0acf7901746e.png[/img]

[h2]A BIG thank you to everyone![/h2]
I want to thank everyone for being part of our journey throughout Early Access! Research Story will not be what it is today without the community's love and amazing support.

Many of you have patiently shared your feedback, suggestions, and bug reports on the Steam forums, and more have shared them through the Google Forms linked in-game. Some of you made detailed guides and videos, and others kindly answered community questions. Reading your lovely and sometimes funny comments always put a smile to my face! 😊💚 Finally, seeing your awesome reviews for the game gives me so much encouragement that the game's on the right track.

I'm really happy that you enjoy Research Story, and I hope that you'll continue to enjoy the 1.0 update very soon! 💕

[h2]Into the future[/h2]
Right now, I'm focused on the preparations for 1.0, and admittedly have not planned (much) for what comes after that! What I can promise is that I'll continue supporting the game the best I can. You know me, I try to respond to all of your comments, feedback and bug reports as much as possible.

After the dust settles, I'll look into more community feedback and see how it goes from there. I'll likely start by working on upgrading my game build to fit the latest version of Gamemaker Studio (the game engine that I use) so that I can tap into more features (specifically, borderless fullscreen and audio input changes on runtime should be available after upgrading). I'll also look into whether I'm able to support Mac/Linux, as I know we have some players on those platforms. These may take weeks or more - it's hard to say. I'll do my best!

Talk soon! In the meantime, if you have any questions, feel free to ask them~
Miki 🤍

notes.title: Patch v0.13.15
notes.content:
Several polishing changes in v0.13.15:

[h3][b]Controls[/b][/h3]
[u]Hotbar + Toolbox controls & UI[/u]
- Items are now automatically held when selected. You can still 'keep' items into your bag.
- Added 'Hold hotbar items automatically' toggle in gameplay options. Default is on, though for the most of Early Access (before v0.13.15), the default has been off.
- A held item is kept when opening the toolbox/equipping a tool.
- [KBM] Toolbox closes when clicking to equip a tool.
- [Visual] While trowel has a crop, hotbar items will have lowered opacity (since they can't be used).
- [Visual] Added cross icon and lowered opacity when tool is not being used (i.e. when the player is holding an item).
- [Visual] Recoloured toolbox. Image for Toolbox tutorial is also updated.
[quote]Dev note: Since the above changes how the game feels to play, I thought to share more about the reason behind the change.

Now and then, I get feedback regarding the controls for hotbar/tools in the game. I think most of it stems from the fact that Research Story gives permanent tools a separate inventory from all the other obtainable items, which is different from how several well-known games in the genre do it. While this has its own perks (tools don't take up the usual bag inventory/you won't forget them in a chest), players may find it more cluncky and unfamiliar. I've given it a lot of thought throughout development, and without re-doing how the game handles tools/bag inventory, I've tried to further improve this aspect of the game.

[b]If you prefer the previous controls, you can toggle 'Hold hotbar items automatically' in Options > Gameplay to Off.[/b][/quote]
[u]Dialogue[/u]
- [Keyboard] Dialogue options can now be cycled through with up/down or up/down arrow keys.
- [Keyboard] Interact/Enter can be used to choose an option.

[h3][b]General Changes[/b][/h3]

[u]Creature Pen[/u]
- Adjusted collision box for adding Feed to creature pen trough.
- Added white outline to trough when hovered over.
- On rainy days, creature pens now have a leaf shelter for creatures (purely cosmetic). The leaf shelter can be opened/closed.

[u]Creature UI[/u]
- Animal portraits are better centered.

[u]Furniture Interaction[/u]
- The Stone Bathtub can now be entered to regenerate Energy.

[u]Options[/u]
- Added '[b]Time pauses at 2AM[/b]' gameplay option. Default is Off.

[u]Misc[/u]
- Fish bait is also shown in the fishing rod above player's head when switching to Fishing Rod.
- Adjustments to several NPC cutscenes: the player will return to where they entered the map instead of where the cutscene ended.

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
- Fixed a typo in Theo's Yellow Heart cutscene.
- Fixed a typo in Let's Make Some! (11) notice.
- Fixed being able to place items in hotsprings.
- Fixed a misalignment of player customisation in a cutscene with Vallee in the Puzzle Cave.
- Fixed a misalignment of player customisation that can happen during Spring/Autumn Festival cutscenes.
- Fixed held item being drawn above player's head during certain Hangout Activities.

More of such small adjustments to come as we prepare for 1.0! ^_^
- Miki

notes.title: 📖 Mini-Devlog #23
notes.content:
[h3][✨The below changes are part of the v1.0 update! Release date will be announced when ready.✨]
[/h3]

[h2]Hi Researchers![/h2]

It's been a while since my last update about the progress towards 1.0! Amidst the minor updates (v0.12, v0.13) that included several QOL features, I've been working hard on the final content for Research Story 1.0.

[h3]📖 Additional Main Story Quests leading to end-credits[/h3]
While the current Main Story Quest (MSQ) does give an 'ending' in the current version of the game, there are some loose ends remaining, as some of you have pointed out. I've added an [b]additional 'Epilogue' segment[/b] to the MSQ, to give a more conclusive end to some of the story elements. It will be a (fairly) short questline that will lead you to the end-credits of the game. Players can continue to enjoy the game and end-game content indefinitely after the end-credits.

Due to spoilers, I can't show you much! I hope you enjoy it when the time comes.

[h3]💍 Proposals and Reverse-Proposals[/h3]
In the full release, players will be able to reach ❤️Red Hearts with all 10 romanceables of the game. Once you reach ❤️Red Hearts, you'll unlock the [b]proposal or reverse-proposal event[/b] specific to each character. A proposal can be scheduled as a [b]Proposal Date[/b] (player-initiated), while a reverse-proposal includes a [b]Proposal Cutscene[/b] from the NPC (NPC-initiated).

During or after those events, you'll be able to gift a Ruby Ring to the character, [b]finalising the engagement[/b]! You'll unlock several [b]Wedding Outfits[/b] in your Wardrobe the following day.

NPC hearts will max out at 🧡 Orange Hearts if they are not romanceable or if the player is already engaged/married.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/988374c16e27f401ac8388377594bedfd64bbb68.png[/img][i]Example of maxed hearts after being engaged/married[/i]

[h3]💐Wedding[/h3]
While engaged, you can [b]schedule your Wedding Day[/b], just like how you'd schedule a Hangout Event. You can even choose the type of decor you'd like for your big day!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/77c352be193ddae291d76bf611829a33da3ab879.gif[/img]
On the day of the Wedding, [b]time is paused in the morning[/b] for you to make preparations (e.g. change into different outfits/hairstyles). Once ready, you can attend the wedding by leaving the house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/59c1a2d96cfa512bec4fe1a32d1546239e5a3584.gif[/img][i]Wedding sneak peek![/i]

Your spouse moves into your home right after the wedding! ✨ Spouses will have new sweet things to say and will continue their usual routines but also spend time in the spouse room.

[h3]📝 What's next[/h3]
I've completed the Red Heart (i.e. proposal) content for all 10 romanceables. Each Red Heart Event is unique to the character and their stories, so it should feel very special~ I'm looking forward to seeing players experience those proposal cutscenes and dates!

I'll be working on [b]unique spouse dialogue and routines[/b] next, as well as some small [b]married life events[/b] (such as celebrating the player's birthday and the couple's wedding anniversary).

After which, I'll start work on the [b]Legendary Research[/b] content, and spend any remaining time adding other end-game content. There are also some artwork-related & polishing tasks that I've left to the end (e.g. Fiances' Wedding Outfits). I'll work on those after the texts are done and I share them with the localisation team (for CN).

All in all, things are progressing well and I'm really looking forward to the full release! As we get closer to the end of Q2 2025, some of you might be curious about the release date. I can only confirm and announce the date when the game is ready, so please give me a bit more time for that. The community has been so patient and supportive, which I'm very thankful for. It surely keeps me going! 

[h3]💛 Community Updates[/h3]
Our Discord recently reached 1000 members! Thank you to everyone for making our community a welcoming and helpful one. It's something I'm always grateful for! I can't say that enough.

Even if you're not on the Discord, thank you so much for playing Research Story, leaving reviews, comments, feedback, bug reports, and questions about the game. I read every single one and I try to respond when I'm able. I'm also thankful for everyone who contributed to our community wiki, and all the videos and live streams for the game - here's one that I enjoyed recently:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9OIRyr6Xdmg

Once again, I really appreciate all of you who have supported the game over the past couple of years in Early Access! Development took longer than expected but we're close to the finishing line, and that's very exciting!

Cheers~
Miki

notes.title: 📖 Mini-Devlog #22
notes.content:
[h3][✨The below changes are part of a minor v0.12 update, which will be available within a week or two!✨][/h3]

[h2]Hi Researchers![/h2]

Here's an update on the progress towards 1.0!

Since January, I’ve worked mainly on three things:
1) Adding Powered Chest item and mechanics
2) Reworking key UI
3) Adding more Game Options

[h3]⚡️ Powered Chest for automated crafting[/h3]
One of the key feedback from players in the latest version of the game is that Crafting Stations (such as the Composter and Stone Forge) can get tedious when crafting large batches of items.

Introducing… Powered Chests!

Powered Chests automate the [b]addition of materials[/b] and [b]collection of crafted items[/b]. Just plop it next to a Crafting Station and add required materials to the chest. Nearby Crafting Stations will grab the needed items and start crafting. When crafting completes, the crafted item is deposited in the chest and the next cycle starts (as long as there are enough materials). The crafting will continue to run even while you’re out exploring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/cdac80a231a8b94f8def11e735356c6dfade7ea7.gif[/img]

[h3]📖 Reworking key UI, such as the Quests UI, and increasing font sizes[/h3]
A UI rework has been on the to-do list for some time. Several parts of the main UI have been reworked:
1) [u]Quests UI is now integrated to the main UI[/u] as one of the tabs, instead of being a standalone page. This was changed due to a recent feedback from a player, and I think it fits nicely in the main UI!
2) [u]Increased the size of the UI[/u], and used larger, more legible fonts for text.
3) [u]Redesigned some UIs[/u] so that information is more clearly portrayed (e.g. NPCs’ and creatures' information)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/687457e4220c8d55a46435d225a3cada29f80498.png[/img][i]New quest UI[/i]

[h3]🎮 More Game Options[/h3]
These gameplay options have been added based on player feedback:
1) [u]Keyboard auto-targeting[/u]: For players primarily playing with a keyboard, turning this on helps with navigating the game without the use of the mouse. Doors and interactable objects are automatically targeted without needing the mouse to hover over them. However, most UI would still require a mouse.
2) [u]Never faint from energy depletion[/u]: If this is on, using energy when the player is at 0 Energy will have no penalty. However, the player will still faint at 3AM (latest bedtime) and progress to the next day.

[h3]📝 Towards 1.0[/h3]
These changes have taken up a considerable amount of development time, and I’ve only been working on the actual v1.0 features and content on the side. It's looking a little hard to keep to the timeline I’ve set in the roadmap (Q1 2025), so I'll have to [b]shift the full release to Q2 2025[/b] to make sure that I don't rush the final stretch of development. The actual release date will only be decided once I have all of the features/content added. In the meantime, I’ll be sure to provide devlogs for notable progress, as I always have.

[h3]💛 Thank you to the RS community 💛[/h3]
We recently passed 10k copies sold and 50k wishlists, which is really, really awesome. Your continued support keeps me going, especially now that we're so close to the finish line.

Recently, I found a pretty fun playthrough of Research Story by REDtm, who completed the available research in the game. Just wanted to share it as I enjoyed watching it myself 😊:
https://youtu.be/X1CNaiRQsyg?si=NRGSXDvOYJ-A1yuv


Cheers!
Miki 🤍

notes.title: 📖 Mini-Devlog #21
notes.content:
[h3][✨v0.11 is in development and will be available at the end of 2024!✨][/h3]

[h2]Hi Researchers![/h2]
I'm wrapping up the major content and features in the upcoming [b]v0.11 Shimmering Update[/b]. Here are some of the new things you'll be seeing in the game!

[h2]Introducing Shimmers ✨[/h2]
For each of our [b]29 tameable creatures[/b], there's now a rare chance for them to spawn as a [b]Shimmer[/b]! Shimmers boasts a different colour, has a shimmering effect, [i]and[/i] drops 2 times their usual Produce. This mechanic is introduced to the game after players obtain the [b]Creature Compendium[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/1d0494228970afa6ac16bd5276df3a58c2b53432.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/13d08b514c8957083b0e8e607a3a661e730b16a8.gif[/img][i]Shimmering Sproutkitten![/i]

[h2]House Upgrade 2 + more Decor 🏡[/h2]
The first house upgrade adds a Kitchen to the basic house. In the upcoming update, it'll also add a washroom! Players that already have an upgraded house will get the new room instantly.

In v0.11, House Upgrade 2 adds a [b]Bedroom with Washroom[/b] and [b]2 additional empty rooms[/b]. Here's a little peek at the Bedroom with a Double Bed as well as some new decor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/84b5cba7c5a43b1aaffbed65382be73ce07339e4.png[/img]

[h2]3 New Crops 🌿[/h2]
[b]3 new crops[/b] have been added! The [b]Desert Coral[/b], [b]Lettice[/b] and [b]Dancer's Heels[/b] can be grown all year round, and have repeated harvest cycles. They were added based on player feedback about the limited accessibility of certain types of plants (Flowers, Vegetables, and Herbs) in some seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/d618e70ba4d62b9095c26b271027247823f3c7b1.gif[/img][i]Desert Coral with repeatable harvests.[/i]

[h2]NPC Orange Heart Events and more dialogue 🧡[/h2]
I've added Orange Heart Cutscenes for all 10 romanceables, and a special Mail that players can receive when they reach Orange Hearts with non-romanceables.

On top of the Heart Events, I've also added some dialogue that's related to current events. This includes dialogue related to Shimmers and the progress of the player in their research or the cave puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/c06d8283d8a7350ee70c1e91b3d1d6dc616861d5.png[/img]

[h2]More useful items!✨[/h2]
Several useful items have been added to the game, including [b]Porter Chests[/b], [b]Mana Capsule (Equipment)[/b], and [b]Display Cases[/b]. Some of these are mid-end game items.
[list]
[*] Items in a Porter Chest can be accessed via another Porter Chest anywhere.
[*] You can use Teleporters and Elevators freely while the Mana Capsule is equipped.
[*] You can place any item in a Display Case.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/458cdec2aea831af23bf1629c42f4bf24af9a307.png[/img]

[h2]What's next 📝[/h2]
As you can see, there's lots to come with our [b]Shimmering Update[/b]! With the important content complete, I'll be spending the next couple of weeks testing, fixing bugs, and adding more QOL features and content that has been requested by players.

The Shimmering Update is also the [b]final major update for Research Story during Early Access, before the full 1.0 release[/b]. We're soo close! A big thank you to everyone who has been supporting us so far. The roadmap remains: our 1.0 release update will include Red Heart Events, a Marriage system, Legendary Research, and a continuation (and completion) of our Main Story Quest.

If you enjoy Research Story and haven't left a review on Steam yet - it'll help very much to leave us a review! 😊🧡

Excited for the update, talk to you again soon!
Miki 🤍

Cheers,

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/fa03749cbd68fdf7e5cc61658362e3197ab28dbb.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings Researchers![/h3]

[b]v0.9 update is now available[/b] for all Researchers to play! Here are some highlights:

[h2]🍻 New NPC, Layla![/h2]
Layla is Lisa's younger sister. She'll be moving into Shimmerbrook from 3 Summer Y1 onwards (on a Wed/Sat/Sun). She has a bubbly and outgoing personality, and you'll see her helping around Mugs & Darts on her work days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/7c1f0dc5c79c490893d3e854583406986cdcb8c8.gif[/img]

- Added 20 Heart Event Cutscenes (non-romanceables)
- Receive more mail as you get closer with the townsfolk
- Casual Hangouts with minigame
- 3 new Side Quests
- New daily routines for several NPCs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/4355c58356360fedfb654a33412c0e19b449e8e9.gif[/img]

[h2]🍳 Cooking System[/h2]
Obtain 5 cooking utensils and craft a variety of food! With 48 cooking recipes, many of the existing crops and animal products will come in handy. Other than being a better source of energy, some food also give certain buffs when eaten.

For researchers who've upgraded their homes, the Food Cabinet can now store items. When cooking, ingredients will be pulled from the cabinet before the players' inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/e6b64def4a4507257e845c232040a0da16720fe4.gif[/img]

[h2]📝 Daily Summary[/h2]
A few of our players have requested this feature (since almost day 1!) and I finally managed to implement it in the game. The daily summary tracks not just your shipped items, but also submitted scrolls and relationship changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/82db284ddc8b97f31dd63226119d8fb3f9ceec86.gif[/img]
[quote][b]Dear Chinese players[/b]: There are still some missing translation related to the new update, but we'll be updating the game as soon as we have them all ready. Sorry for the delay and thank you for your patience![/quote]
There's lots of other smaller changes as part of this update - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1629830/view/4155212136886267874?l=english]full patch notes here[/url].

[h2]✨1.0 Roadmap Update!✨[/h2]
The Early Access for Research Story has gone on for longer than I had initially planned, so thank you to all researchers for your patience! We're getting closer each day, and I now have more clarity on the remaining updates towards 1.0. Here's an updated roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/b879c03982cae89372e31fbd4b1f7a54cb697347.png[/img]

Finally, thank you so much again for playing Research Story! The game wouldn't be where it is today without your feedback and bug reports. A big portion of the v0.9 update came from player suggestions, from something as large as the Cooking System, to the more innovative Casual Hangout system, to smaller QOL features like the Daily Summary and balancing changes. These are all implemented because players wanted it!

As we go on towards 1.0, there are also other areas where player suggestions will be implemented, including adding a Wardrobe (in the v0.10 small content update); more decor and specifically, display cases; alongside major content such as the continuation of the Main Story Quest (players wanted more after the current MSQ ends, and better worldbuilding in general)... I hope to cover as much as possible, but being a sole developer for the most part, I'll have to prioritise certain additions over others (I'm sure you already know!). Regardless, keep your feedback coming so that I get a sense of whether we're heading in the right direction, and know where else to improve!

That's all for now! I hope you enjoy the update!
Miki 🤍

notes.title: 📖 Mini-Devlog #18
notes.content:
[h3][✨v0.9 is in development, to be released by the end of next week!✨][/h3]

[h2]Hello Researchers![/h2]

It's been a while since the last devlog - I just wanted to do another update before v0.9 goes live! Many things have been in development, and all the to-do list in our last devlog and more has been implemented:
[list]
💚 Non-romanceables Green Heart Events
✉️ Non-romanceables Blue Heart and Yellow Heart Mail
🍕 More cooking recipes and food effects
👫 New Hangout Type: Casual Hangouts
🎯 5 New Steam Achievements
✨QOL changes
[/list]
Here are some of the more visible/interesting changes! Many of these has been requested by players, including a daily summary, casual (repeatable) hangouts, and better shipping box UI.

[h3]✨Daily Summary✨[/h3]
When players head to bed at the end of the day, a daily summary will show the key progress made by the player. Other than [b]shipped items[/b], [b]submitted research scrolls[/b] and [b]relationship changes[/b] are also tracked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/82db284ddc8b97f31dd63226119d8fb3f9ceec86.gif[/img]
[h3]💛Casual Hangouts💛[/h3]
[b]Casual, repeatable hangouts[/b]! Hangouts are now categorised into two types: Story Hangouts and Casual Hangouts. Story Hangouts (the ones currently in the game) can only be completed once, and has unique dialogue and character development. On the other hand, you can go on Casual Hangouts as many times as you wish. Currently, only the Garden location has been added for Casual Hangouts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/26e8b3afb05e1c14df08c41ab21971619d0bf880.gif[/img]
This lets players hang out with NPCs beyond the fixed number of Story Hangouts, and gives an alternative way for players to [b]increase Relationship Points[/b] with [b]any [/b]NPC! To make these casual hangouts more eventful, I've also implemented a minigame where players can [b]collect hearts or complete activities[/b] to fill up the satisfaction meter of the NPC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/4355c58356360fedfb654a33412c0e19b449e8e9.gif[/img]
[h3]🍳Food Effects🍳[/h3]
As part of the cooking system, 24 out of 48 of the cooked items have [b]Effects[/b]. This can range from things like getting a [b]higher chance of finding a specific gem in the mines[/b], to things like [b]Energy Regeneration[/b]. These Food Effects are separate from Potion buffs, and can stack with effects from worn Equipment. Look at the regen go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/101ea411e9fa80a340e673ec8f620ebd25924351.gif[/img]
[h3]📦Updated shipping box UI, 2 more hotbar slots (6 -> 8 slots)📦[/h3]
The Shipping Box now shows the first 32 shipped items, but players can continue adding to it infinitely. The number of slots that our hotbar has is also increased from 6 to 8 slots. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/6f446297254418be6e772d3fcf4421fbce90499b.jpg[/img]

[h3]What's after v0.9?[/h3]
Pretty exciting stuff, eh? :) I hope you're looking forward to the update! I'll be sharing a more detailed roadmap to 1.0 together with the update next week, but I'm looking at [b]2 more major content updates[/b] (including the 1.0 update), along with several smaller updates in between them. We're slowly but surely getting there!

Cheers!
Miki 🤍

[h2]Greetings Researchers![/h2]
I'm currently working on the v0.9 update, which will be quite a big update! Here's what you can expect:
[list]
[*] [b]More NPC Heart Events[/b]! All non-romanceable Purple Heart Events have been added thus far.
[*] A [b]new character[/b] will be moving into Shimmerbrook! [b]Layla [/b]will be helping around Mugs & Darts, and you'll see her either being a barmaid or shopkeeping on her work days~

[h2]Layla, NPC Character interactions 💛[/h2]
Here's an example of new NPC interactions! Talking to them will prompt a dialogue where they speak to each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/7c1f0dc5c79c490893d3e854583406986cdcb8c8.gif[/img][i]Hello Layla![/i]

[h2]Cooking System + Crafting Food from Chest 🍳[/h2]
Being a life sim, many players want to cook in the game! With the numerous interesting plants and produce that can be found in Shimmerbrook, I thought we could make a familiar system with unique recipes.

Players will be able to obtain 5 different [b]Cooking Utensils[/b], which are required for various recipes. For example, you can cook Scrambled Eggs on a Pan, and make Mashed Potatoes with a Bowl & Whisk. (Cooking Utensils was one of my favourite things about Harvest Moon FOMT, and I really wanted to add this!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/0670cba9fbc98099bbdd2dd8623d8ec117634840.gif[/img]
To make cooking more meaningful, some food will provide players with effects for the day when eaten.
[i]Effects from food may still change during development![/i]

The Food Cabinet (currently in-game), will be interactable and act as a chest. When making food, ingredients will be [b]automatically grabbed from the Food Cabinet[/b] first before the Player Inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/1516356acc7f526804e1bbe7442b56855c45e83e.gif[/img]
Players can obtain recipes primarily from NPCs, reading the Noticeboard, and the Caravan.

[h3]To-do List 📝[/h3]
Here are some of the things I'll be working on next:
[list]
[*] Non-romanceables Green Heart Events
[*] Non-romanceables Blue Heart and Yellow Heart Mail
[*] Remaining cooking recipes and their effects.
[*] QOL changes (e.g. Autocrafters to take from chests before player inventory).
[*] New Steam Achievements related to the update
[/list]
Thank you for reading! What else do you wish to see in the v0.9 update?

Cheers~

notes.title: ✨1st Year Anniversary Update!✨
notes.content:
[h2]1st Year Anniversary and State of EA[/h2]
Hello Researchers! It's about a year since Research Story launched into Early Access! 🎉 Initially, I planned to reach 1.0 at around 1 year after the EA release, but the scope of the game grew and it will take a bit longer to get ready. While I work on larger content updates, here's an [b]Anniversary Update (v0.7.11)[/b] that has some of the common player-requested QOL features! I hope you enjoy these additions.

[h2]v0.7.11 Update Notes[/h2]
[h3]New QOL Features & Content![/h3]
- Added random name generator for creatures.
- Added a 'Move' button for Creature Pens.
- Added Shoulder Bag! Buy from the General Store for 8 additional slots in the inventory.
- Added Iron Chests, which can store more items than normal chests. Can be painted.
- Added Item Signs! Sold at the Carpenter Shop. Can be painted.
- Added Paths! Paths can be crafted and placed outdoors. Sold at the Carpenter Shop and Stoneworks.
- Added Wood Path.
- Added Darkwood Path.
- Added Stone Path.
- Added ability to hold RMB to pick up Fences and Paths quickly.
- Added new SFX for footsteps for grass, wood and stone paths.
- Added Darkwood Plank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/b1223629c6e5580db688836de6190586862d91c1.png[/img][i]Additional row of inventory slots (unlockable).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/f887074c499b8bf216df0f461d84a2c4be6eeb51.gif[/img][i]Decorating with some of the new items![/i]

[h3]QOL & Balancing Changes[/h3]
- Item price and materials required can now be seen in each row of shop items.
- Crafting Stations (Composters, Forges etc.) now drop items near the player instead of towards the bottom of the station.
- Added new Job Board Requests, and adjusted existing requests.
- Job Board Requests now take seasons into account.
- Increased Ruby and Gilded Gem spawn rates in the [spoiler]Lava Mines[/spoiler], especially when you go deeper.
- Increased Emerald and Sky Quartz spawn rates on Floors [spoiler]55-59[/spoiler];
- Changed some plant and creature spawn boundaries in the Mines.
- Improved UX for Recording Station UI. Scrollbar would no longer refresh every time the Books Menu is returned to.
- Tiny Flower can now be used to make Kelp Fertiliser.
- Tiny Flower can now be used with the Dehydrator to get 1x Fiber.
- Yellow Blue Fur can now be used in the Spinning Wheel.
- Yellow Blue Fur and Glaciroll drops can now be used with the Composter.
- Hard Stone now works as a stone instead of a material in the Magic Forge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/fa9b32545729cbc3727e9a5767098412b7c83247.png[/img][i]Rhea requesting for Hydranbear in Autumn.[/i]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug with fishing where the player reels in nothing even though they clicked while the exclamation mark is showing.
- NPCs who are sleeping will no longer react to the Bell.
- Fixed a repeating dialogue by Sesame.
- Player right clicking on a creature and a placed item will prioritise the creature.
- Fixes for clashes between fishing and opening of chests.
- Fixed being able to open chest and Autofeeder inventories at the same time.
- Fixed being able to open Feed Crafter/Bait Press and Autofeeder inventories at the same time.
- Fixed being able to use drill at the bottom of the Mines ([spoiler]Floor 80[/spoiler]).
- Fixed a bug where item prices are not unlocked after shipping.
- Fixed a bug with Sun Lamp + Sprinklers combination that causes some normal sun lamps to work as higher-tier sun lamps.
- Fixed a bug that caused some Gloomberries to stop regrowing.
- Fixed a bug where Lisa's name shows "???" even though player has already met her.
- [CN Localisation] Fixed some translation errors.

[h3]Controller Updates[/h3]
- Fixed being able to talk to nearby NPCs while fishing, which causes a softlock.
- Changed the default option to "No" when returning to the surface of the Mines.
- Fixed reading signs while trying to fish.
- Fixed talking to NPCs while trying to fish.
- While the player is facing the water with fishing rod and bait, fishing is prioritised.
- Improved UX for Shops. Items are automatically selected without having to press 'A' first.
- Improved UX for Recording Station UI. D-pad can now be used for selecting books.

[h3]Steam Deck[/h3]
- Fixed duplicate buttons on the Main Menu (Language and Discord buttons).

[h2]Remaining content updates for Early Access[/h2]
Here are the key content updates I wish to complete before 1.0 is ready:
[list]
[*] Creatures research update (part 2): Rare, 'variant' creatures (called Shimmers) + better creature management
[*] Heart Events for non-romanceable NPCs
[*] More content for romanceable NPCs, including Orange & Red Heart Events
[*] Other life-sim mechanics, such as Cooking
[*] End-game content: Legendary Research, Marriage + Married Life Events
[*] Misc: Side Quests, more decor items
[/list]To all our players and fans, thank you so much for all your amazing support on our journey! When I first started developing this game, I thought I'd make a small game over the span of a year. I worked on Research Story almost daily, and before I knew it, it's been over 3 years... But I still remain motivated to build it further - both because I enjoy the process, and because of every bit of support that you've showed along the way. We wouldn't be here without you. So really, thank you! 💗

In the meantime, I'll continue to make the game the best that I can. As usual, I'll be here if you have any questions, comments, or feedback! Have a great week! :)

Miki

notes.title: Some words and updated roadmap - 6 months into Early Access!
notes.content:
[h2]Some words and thanks[/h2]
It's been about half a year since launch, and I just want to say a HUGE thank you to our players and community - we truly wouldn't be here without you! ❤️❤️ All your streams, playthroughs, feedback, suggestions, reports, and comments have been an important part of the development process, and have shaped Research Story one way or another.

Research Story has come quite a long way. I started working on the game in October 2020, which is close to 3 years ago. What started as a little indie dream has evolved into something that I see myself doing for a long time. I remember my elation seeing my first 100 followers on Twitter - people were interested in my game! Today, we have close to 4,000 players, 8,000 followers on Twitter and 37,000 wishlists - something that I could have only hoped to achieve. The support and interest for the game is something that I'm always grateful for, and certainly part of what keeps me going! So again, thank you all from the bottom of my heart.

[h2]✨Updated Roadmap✨[/h2]
I think it's a good time to look back at the past 6 months and update our roadmap. I plan to focus on NPC stories in Sep-Oct as part of the [b]v0.6 NPC & Romance update[/b]. From Nov-Dec, we'll work on a [b]major update, the v0.7 Creatures & Caves update[/b], which would include new and improved content for creatures, a more differentiated mining experience, the Winter Festival, and more. Here's the updated roadmap:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/e9547293fd12832fb343d8274aee2d5d57b9dcff.png[/img]
[i]Updated Roadmap, with plans for Q4 2023 and beyond.[/i]

Looking back at our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1629830/view/3656396815346372558?l=english]initial plans[/url], we're still on track to complete our roadmap (and more!) for this Early Access release. Since release, we've added [b]full controller support, multiple QOL and bugfix updates, automation, several festivals, 7 new OSTs[/b], as well as [b]additional dialogue and decor content[/b] to the game.

One of the things we've added that wasn't part of the initial roadmap is the [b]CN localisation[/b], which sets the foundation for adding other languages in the future. We decided to add it earlier in the game's development to minimise the time needed to rework the game during the localisation process.

We are also adding a new update category (v0.7 Creatures and Caves Update) after hearing from players - players wanted a [b]deeper and broader system relating to creature research[/b]! We'll work through the details in a couple of months' time, but I already have some ideas about making it a fun and cute update. Stay tuned!

[h2]Final words[/h2]
We hope you've been enjoying the Early Access journey with us so far! Time is passing so quickly and I can see the game getting closer to 1.0 every day. There's still a bit to go, including a bunch of content relating to NPCs and research. I plan to have the Legendary Research and Marriage Updates in 2024, closer to the 1.0 release, as part of the end-game content.

As usual, we're always super happy to hear from you! Any comments from players are always appreciated, and I try to respond to most of them. If you have any questions, suggestions, ideas about the game, the [url=https://researchstory.fandom.com/wiki/Research_Story_Wiki]community-led Wiki[/url], or anything else - come share them with our Discord community! We're almost at 700 members and will be happy to have you 🥰 Or share them on Steam as I check it quite often too! 👍 Also, tell us who should we add as a romance candidate next!! 💗

notes.title: Mini-Devlog #7 Localisation in progress!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Researchers![/h3]

This Devlog is about adding localisation to Research Story - it's a little more technical than our usual posts!

At this time, we can only confirm that we'll be localising the game to [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] - we'll look into other languages in the future! Thank you to our Chinese fans who have been interested in the game and waiting for CN, it's on the way!~ ❤️

[h3]Localising the game - properly! 📝✨[/h3]
Together with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/40932910]Electronic Sheep Games[/url], who have been working on the localisation of the texts itself, I have been working on the implementation of the localised texts into the game. While our Demo has localisation, I wanted to do things in a better way for our Early Access version. This is so that when we plan to have more languages in the future, it wouldn't take as long to do so.

With over 5000 rows of texts in Excel and over 45,000 words (and counting), it's no simple task! This is a snippet of how [b]Kipp's Dialogue data[/b] looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/3a46184600f7b077c963aac9c8ef99c7974ab824.png[/img]
It has a unique ID (state), English texts for normal dialogue and options, and the translated columns.

All other texts, from a single word in a UI such as "Research" to Item Names and Descriptions all require similar treatment.

I had to make sure that each line was read from the Excel Sheets instead of being written directly into the game engine itself. If there were any in the engine, I had to move it to the Excel Sheet and give it a unique ID to reference in the code. Even though a large part of the game was already written in the Excel, I still spent maybe 4-5 full days (8 hr+) replacing the remaining written texts with the unique IDs. I did so much Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and other Ctrl Shortcuts that my left pinkie started hurting even after a night's sleep 😰😰 Glad to say it's all good now, and most of the [i]intense[/i] copy-pasting due to my prior lack of foresight have been completed 🎉🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/ffe3de7813ffd70a9e06d10c74d3fed9832f4a48.png[/img]
[i]Being a Chinese Singaporean, I feel particularly excited when seeing CN in the game! Since I can read a bit of Chinese, it feels like I'm playing RS for the first time again - the texts are so refreshing. And yes, I was influenced by my Chinese roots when creating the General Store and its characters! ❤️[/i]

[h3]Other Visuals 🔍[/h3]
Other than the game title, there aren't many texts in-game that was drawn as an image (thankfully!). The Darts Minigame is one part of the game that has drawn texts, which would require appropriate localisation too:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/a52b85fbb4aa70c5391d7e7f225f3c114f17b18f.png[/img]

[h3]Keeping optimisation in mind 💭[/h3]
In our Demo, there were some optimisation issues where adding CN led to longer loading times when changing the language and when returning to the main menu. This was mainly due to the loading of fonts, and I've prevented those issues from happening in our Early Access build!

[h3]What's Next 📝[/h3]
We'll be doing QA for the localised build before offering it in one of the future updates. Again, shoutout to Electronic Sheep who has been doing great work!! We're excited to share the update with you when it's ready.

I'll be going back to bugfixes + ramping up the next part of content updates, which I need some time to think about!

Hope everyone's been enjoying the v0.3 update so far!

Miki

notes.title: Alfie's Awesome Automations is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/d734c422de80471cb86ac350c0b03ff74842ee1f.png[/img]

Greetings Researchers!

We're happy to bring you our very first major content update, [b]'Alfie's Awesome Automations'[/b]!

This update focuses on automation in the game. We decided to work on this aspect of the game for a few reasons:
[list]
[*]It gives a new progression goal for players to automate and optimise their farms.
[*]It is an important part of base management, and contributes to overall QOL of the game by reducing repetition of tedious work.
[*]Alfie's Shop exterior was already added the game, but with a placeholder to prevent entry as it did not make it for the initial release. Now, all existing buildings in the game can be entered.
[/list]
[h2]Automation Features[/h2]

[h3]Farming: Sprinklers, Sun Lamps! 💧☀️[/h3]
Three tiers of sprinklers and sun lamps can be unlocked, covering a 3x3, 5x5, and 7x7 area. Sprinklers and Sun Lamps can be stacked to make use of the same tile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/9edf482ecee7418164766ea0fa197ff0b7a1e52f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/4c9fcd91f815fe9c710fc8308f389673f61c4610.png[/img]

[h3]Ranching: Auto-Collectors, Bell Tool 🔔[/h3]
Auto-Collectors can be placed on the farm, and collect both creature drops and produce from adjacent pens.

The Bell Tool can be purchased for easier management of creatures. Ring the bell using Right Click to make creature followers go back to their pens. Ring the bell using Left Click to make all followers go back to their pens. The Bell only works in the Farm area, where pens are located.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/44f4cd4a7dcd236bb498f8f2c0c3526bb9207d5c.gif[/img]

[h3]Crafting: Bait Press and Feed Crafter 📦[/h3]
We've heard feedback from several players, saying that crafting from the inventory can get tedious after some time when clicking through the menus. After considering several options, we decided to add two items: Bait Press and Feed Crafter, which can quickly craft some of the oft-required items. These crafters also pull from adjacent chests - one of the things we've heard players want to see!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/bae4119910ec395501476dbb54d788158e785d65.gif[/img]

[h3]Resource Gathering: Fish Nets and Auto-Tappers 🐟🌳[/h3]
The Fish Net can yield certain items every 3-5 days when placed in water with bait. It usually yield mollusks, shells, and other items but can sometimes yield fish. We balanced it this way so that Fish Nets don't diminish the purpose of some creatures that help with getting fish.

The Auto-Tapper works on Fir trees and Maple trees, getting tapped materials every 4 and 10 days respectively:
- Resin from Fir trees
- Maple Syrup from Maple trees

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/bd2243346bf8f5a8ef508560c258be1b4fabbcd4.gif[/img][i]In the end, this scene looks very Stardew-esque. While I tried to add new things (e.g. Lily Pads that can be placed in water), this resource-gathering mechanic is just so simple and intuitive that I didn't change it much. I hope players will enjoy it regardless![/i]

[h3]Decor Sets and Items 🪑[/h3]
We've added some decor sets and items, along with some rotateable furniture (Chairs and Lily Pads to start with).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/044be3c3cdb7a295b12b6d337590be31fc18ee74.gif[/img]

[h2]Full v0.3 Patch Notes[/h2]
We've also added a bunch of other content, fixed bugs, and made some balancing changes to the game. They can be found in the full v0.3 Patch Notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1629830/view/3696939164842027447?l=english]here[/url].

[h2]Research Story is on Sale until July 13![/h2]
During the Steam Summer Sale, Research Story is [b]10% off[/b]!

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game in one way or another. You've been an important part of the development of Research Story and I'm excited to continue building the game with you! If you have any questions, suggestions, or comments, I'll be here to read them.

[h2]What's next 📝[/h2]
I'll be spending some time on the outstanding bugs (I know there are some bugs that have persisted for a few patches, I'll be looking at them again ;; ). Along with that, I'll be cleaning up the code base, which may not translate to new things immediately but will be good for the game in the long term. It'll also mean starting to implement localisation (specifics TBA).

Once I feel more ready to tackle the next content patch, I'll share more about it! I'm thinking of working on NPCs next. As usual, I'll keep in touch using Mini-Devlogs and on our Discord!

Happy Researching!
- Miki

notes.title: v0.2 Cloud Save: Save file conflict issues and guide
notes.content:
We have received a few reports regarding save files not showing in the game after the v0.2 update, for players who have played Research Story on [b]2 or more separate devices prior to the update[/b]. [u]If you've played on multiple devices and have yet to launched RS since the v0.2 update, we suggest that you do a manual backup (see Part 1) of your save files before launching the game.[/u]

This guide covers potential issues and how to resolve them. At any one point, if you're unsure of the steps, [b]don't hesitate to reach out to us directly via Steam, Discord, or email[/b]!

[h2][b][Part 1] Checking for your saves + manual backup[/b][/h2]
If you've played RS on 2 separate devices prior to the v0.2 update and cannot see some of your save files in the game after the update, please check for your save files by following the below steps:
1) Open Run app (Windows + R key)
2) Copy this to the field: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ResearchStory\
3) Press Ok.
4) In the "Saves" folder, check if the save is there (0_Player_savedgame.save). There may be two files with the same starting number "0_...". If so, the save still exists but is not showing in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/08628008d1fd55f081fc2093fd3d97960d5e501c.png[/img]

If you can't find your save file in the "Saves" folder, check your second device [u]before[/u] launching the game. If it exists, [b]⚠️please do a manual backup of the saves by copying + pasting all folders somewhere safe[/b] (e.g. your desktop) before continuing with the below steps. If you can't find it on any of your devices, please write to petalcatgames@gmail.com and I'll respond to you directly.

[h2][b][Part 2] Checking your .info files[/b][/h2]
Once you find your .save files and do a [b]manual backup (see Part 1)[/b], the next step is to check your .info files in the 'SavesInfo' folder. These are responsible for locating the saves and showing them when you press 'Play' in game.

For each .save file, there should be a corresponding .info file. For most affected players, the issue arises when there are missing .info files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/f7ecfe8b6ca41dc33a9587686b8dae7b23c9d226.png[/img]

[h2][b][Part 3] Duplicating .info files[/b][/h2]
For the case in the images above, the player has two .save files (PlayerA and PlayerB) but only one .info file. To resolve this:
1) In the SavesInfo folder: Copy + Paste the [b]0_SaveInfo.info[/b] file in the same folder. Rename the copied file to [b]1_SaveInfo.info[/b]
2) In the Saves folder: Rename [b]0_PlayerB_savedgame.save[/b] to [b]1_PlayerB_savedgame.save[/b]
3) Launch the game. It should show the 2 save files instead of 1. However, the player customisation would be duplicated for both of them.

[h2][b][Part 4] Remaking a .info file with correct customisation[/b][/h2]
1) Create a new character with your preferred player customisation, naming the character the name of the player character you're fixing (e.g. PlayerB). Skip the introduction cutscene. The game will be autosaved after the cutscene and creates a new [b]2_SaveInfo.info file[/b]. If you have more than 2 saves, the save you're working with is the newest file that has the largest number prefix.

[i]You can continue these steps in the File Explorer while the game is running:[/i]
2) Delete the 1_SaveInfo.info file that is has incorrect customisation.
3) Rename the new 2_SaveInfo.info to 1_SaveInfo.info.
4) In the Saves folder, delete the 2_PlayerB_savedgame.save that was created for the purpose of this fix. Keep your original 1_PlayerB_savedgame.save.
5) Go back to the game, go to main menu and press play again. You should be able to see the changes.

[h2]Other issues and contact[/h2]
If you run into further issues regarding your save files, please reach out to us via Steam, on Discord, or drop us a message at petalcatgames@gmail.com. We'll do our best to work things out with you! Thank you to everyone for your understanding and patience.

- Miki

[h3]Greetings Researchers![/h3]

The controller support update is live! 🎉 More information below:

[u][h2]v0.2 Update Notes[/h2][/u]
[h3]🎮Controller Support[/h3]
- The game can now be played with an Xbox controller.
- The game will detect the control scheme (Keyboard/Mouse or Controller) and change its display accordingly when receiving an input.
- Input prompts will be displayed in-game as glyphs, and an in-game keyboard has been implemented for naming the player and creatures.
- Implemented tool wheel for switching tools.
- Most of the gamepad controls can be remapped from the Options Menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/5fcdc1cc5a71eb1ca1c42e2e235fc804fbb8f545.png[/img]
[i]Happy with how the keyboard turned out![/i]

[h3]✨Improvements[/h3]
[u]Reduced some tedium when managing multiple creatures[/u]
- Hold the interact key (LMB or A) to pat multiple creatures, without having to click on them individually (similar to harvesting crops).
- Collecting a creature produce will also count as 'patting' the creature. This reduces the number of interacts needed when managing creatures.
- For wild/untamed creatures that have been observed, interacting with them will get them to drop an item without a popup. Interacting again will bring up a popup dialogue with their diet information. This reduces unnecessary clicks to close the popup in mid-later game.
[u]Clearer UI[/u]
- Going back from the Customisation page shows a confirmation popup (to warn that any changes made in the customisation will be lost).
- When attempting to delete a save, the confirmation popup will show the player name of the save to be deleted.
- Display "Loading..." when loading a save.
[u]Optimisation[/u]
- Optimised some parts of the code, and fixed a bug which led to unnecessary instances being created when you own a farm teleporter. This should help with lags occuring after year 1.

[h3]💻Better Support for some wider resolutions[/h3]
- To better support larger resolutions, all hand-drawn art were resized and imported so that the quality is kept. I've done passes for the following resolutions: [b]3840x2160, 3440x1440, and 5120x1440[/b].
- For 32:9 resolutions like 5120x1440, the start menu should no longer be cut off.
- Increased font sizes for some fonts, especially for resolutions larger than 1920x1080.
- The game should also be more zoomed in for larger resolutions (consistent with how it looks on 1920x1080).

[h3]☁️Cloud Saves[/h3]
- Steam Auto-cloud has been enabled for the game. You can verify that your saves are on the cloud if the Cloud Status states that it's "Up to date" (see below).
- If the 'Cloud Status' doesn't show, you can check your Steam's [b]Settings > Cloud > Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for applications which support it[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/f90e42fe1f3c063f5dbf94f2936052b828c59294.png[/img]

[i]⚠️ IMPORTANT: For Cloud Saves, I could only test on the Windows PC & laptop that I own. I'm unable to test for cross-platform saves (such as to Linux/Steam Deck) at this time. As such, it may not work as expected for cross-platforms. Please help us by letting us know if it works for you, and we'll work on resolving any issues![/i]

[h3]📂Backups[/h3]
- A save file backup system has been added. Backup saves will be created whenever players save their game. This will help mitigate issues with save file corruptions (e.g. when the PC shuts down while saving).
- For existing players, a set of backup files will be created on launch if there are any existing saves.
- You can find your saves and backup saves by following these steps:
1) Open Run app (Windows + R key)
2) Copy this to the field: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ResearchStory\
3) Press Ok.

[u][h2]📝What's next[/h2][/u]
Phew! This was quite a hefty update, but I'm glad to have worked on the important technical stuff before moving on to adding more content! 🎉 After patching any critical issues that may come with this update, I'll work on the Inventory QOL as promised. After that, we'll work on the first major content update (Will share details soon!)

Hope you enjoy the changes! I've been enjoying sitting back while playtesting the game myself :)
- Miki

It mostly worked, but there was an issue with overlapping interactables (e.g. creatures in their pens - we could only target the pen and not the creature). As such, we implemented a sorting system to prioritise common tasks (such as trough and creatures), and also a way to toggle between the nearest objects by pressing RS. Players can also use RS as a mouse cursor.

[h3]Optimisation ✨[/h3]
I’ve also reworked and optimised some parts of the code, which hopefully helps with the lag that some players are facing after playing for about a year in-game.

[h3]What's next[/h3]

[h3]Greetings Researchers!
[/h3]
It's only been a week since release, and we have already seen so many researchers joining us and exploring Shimmerbrook! Thank you to everyone for enjoying our game, and for your questions, bug reports, feedback, and suggestions! We've fixed most of the major known bugs to date and will continue to work on remaining issues in the coming weeks. Since we've received lots of initial feedback as well, we wanted to address some of them in this update.

[h3][u]Here are some changes made since release, based on the feedback we've received:[/u][/h3]

[b]- Some crops such as corn can now be used to craft Vegetable Bowls and Veggie Bait.
- Some crops such as corn now fulfils the Veggie-lover trait.[/b]
[i]Due to Summer not having a Vegetable-type crop implemented yet, we're making these changes to facilitate gameplay. These changes are likely temporary, until we add a conventional Vegetable to Summer.[/i]

[b]- Seeds needed for Seed Bowl Recipe reduced from 3 to 2.[/b]
[i]This was changed as the Seed Bowl recipe can be hard to maintain in the late-game or when a new season starts. Players also can't use 3 different seeds for the recipe due to how crafting works.[/i]

[b]- There's now a 5% base chance for double Fiber drops, even with no Scythe upgrade.
- Added a new early to mid-game item, 'Dehydrator', to have more Fiber options once Summer hits and Fertilisers are required. The Dehydrator can be crafted and processes Flowers into Fiber.
- Increased Stick drop rates from chopping trees. Large trees now drop at least 2 sticks, while small trees drop at least 1. There's also a chance for Sticks to drop when shaking a tree.[/b]
[i]Balancing for Fiber and Sticks, as they're generally hard to get but also very useful.[/i]

[b]- Added Base Energy Slider in Gameplay Options (adjust base energy, up to 100 energy)
- More Energy options: Added a way to roast potatoes and chestnuts using a craftable 'Campfire' item. Prior to this, we had no cooking mechanic in the game. This is a very basic cooking system, let us know what else you'd like to see![/b]
[i]The low base energy affects the experience for some players. We want to give more options to our players![/i]

[b]- Added diet options for some creatures: Seafood for Sproutkittens and Vegetables for Boars.[/b]
[b]- Added Cottontail as a thread material for the Spinning Wheel.[/b]
[i]These are minor adjustments based on player feedback.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/2ef31128e7fce413e3e308cff0828821a5e194f5.png[/img]
[i]New craftables: Campfire and Dehydrator[/i]

[h3][u]Bugfixes in v0.1.24[/u][/h3]
- Fixed a bug where released creatures were still showing up in the list when assigning creatures to Pens.
- Fixed inconsistencies in descriptions between Journal and Item descriptions for some fish.
- Fixed 'Caught Perch for the first time!' bug even though you've caught a Perch before.
- Fixed a possible crash when entering the Observatory.
- Fixed a few typos and text errors.

[h3][u]What's next[/u][/h3]
[b]✨Controller Support and Cloud Saves[/b]
We'll start working on controller support, as we think that it's important to get that working properly early on! Together with controller support, we thought it made sense to implement cloud saves, as that'll facilitate players with multiple devices (e.g. PC & Steam Deck).
[b]✨Inventory and Storage QOL[/b]
This is a highly-requested QOL feature that we'll work on as soon as we can. Among all the suggestions, we found a few important ones that we'll add to the game first:
- Auto-sort
- Auto-add to chest, auto-pull from chest
- Coloured chests
We think this is a good start to improving inventory management, and will continue improving it in the future.

Thanks again for your feedback and suggestions - they have been great and we're very happy to be building the game with the community!

notes.content:

[h2]Building interiors and map update 🏡[/h2]
More building interiors have been added. Some rooms require a certain level of friendship with specific NPCs to enter!

[h2]NPC Stories 💜[/h2]
[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]
Various cutscenes will be triggered as you progress the story, and as you get closer to townsfolk. Here's an example of one involving Vallee and Suo'e:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/c4880352432d28f117b70b67b31ae013f646908f.png[/img]

[h3]Routines[/h3]
Townsfolk will have different routines based on: 1) Whether they are working that day or not; and 2) Weather. For example, most townsfolk will stay indoors when it rains, engaging in a different activity. They will also have different dialogues during different times of the day depending on where they are/what they are doing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/b91ee3288b379c692f2f8a3d5a6e3b0f502c5b29.png[/img]

[h2]Fatigue/Fainting System 💦[/h2]
Players mentioned that there isn’t much penalty to using up energy other than decreased speed. I’ve added a fatigue and fainting system: players move and act more slowly when fatigued, and the day is skipped if players faint. This gives the energy system more meaning, and also makes eating food more important!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/6739ef45d7cff4bbd698e06a3d2a1bf2572fd43f.png[/img]
[i]Player fainting from working too much[/i]

I’ve added more creature traits, a way to release tamed creatures, and even different types of creature pens that are required by specific creatures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/f81002e77d6d7d92b74a36af6d61669d33dcfdc6.png[/img]

[h3]Content for a few more researchables[/h3]
There will be at least [b]60+ researchables[/b] in Early Access, which includes plants, creatures, and fish - most of them are already added but there’s still some testing/balancing to do, and I hope to add just a few more on top of what we have now.
[h3]Mines[/h3]
Finally, I’m also working on a [b]Mines area[/b] where players can collect their ores - will share that when it’s more complete.

Well, that’s all for now, see you next month! <3
- Miki

The new format gives more clarity, uses larger fonts, and looks prettier in my opinion :) This also means I can have more flexibility in the types and number of research tasks for each plant/creature/fish without things looking too cluttered, which leads us to… varied research mechanics!

Now, plants and creatures can have different research tasks tagged to them. For example, some creatures require you to find and record their footprints! 🐾✨

Identifying a Sproutkitten footprint sample.

One of the new creatures is a bunny-mon called Grassbun. It has a unique interaction where it becomes alert and runs when you get close! You can now crouch in the game to approach it successfully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/30f6484ccdeabeff96328c4071a8bd415b98ecaa.png[/img]

[h2]More fish 🐟[/h2]
I’ve also added more fish to the game - here are some common fish and different baits for fishing. When players have more than one type of bait in their inventory, the first bait will be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/821855aae84eaa5176998e2adc9d655a463c88f3.png[/img]

[h2]Summer vibes and summer crops 🌻[/h2]
The summer seasonal tileset is complete, and Sunflowers are one of the crops that is in season! Crops now move a little when players move through them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/10e630aeb1df79a7ce6c59f8c8c5339696d75e12.gif[/img]

[h2]New crop growth requirement: Soil types 🌱[/h2]
In Research Story, knowing what conditions crops require to fully grow (and not wither) is important. Plants will have [u]1-3 “Growing Conditions”[/u] that need to be met for them to grow. So far, these conditions can be a mix of any of the following: 1) Season 2) Distance to a water source, 3) Amount of sun/shade, and even 4) Weather when the seeds are sowed.
Now, there are also specific [b]soil types[/b] that a crop may need. These are loosely based on real-life uses of fertilisers and soil acidity for optimal plant growth. These fertilisers can be crafted or bought.

We’ve built the foundations and core pillars of the game - research, farming, building, creature taming, fishing, and NPC relationships. [u]From this point on, I’ll be implementing the full storyline (main quests), adding content and progression, and deepening existing mechanics[/u].
