We added a few exciting systems this month, all relating to [b]building relationships with the townsfolk[/b].

[h2]Calendar ✨[/h2]
A [b]calendar[/b] has been added to the main UI, which players can [b]access at any time[/b]. It tracks the townfolks’ birthdays (those you have talked to will have their icons revealed), upcoming Hangout Events, and other Festivals (Festival content to be added in the future).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/b0d332f137b554a1b9a4e11c1eecbdd816075c00.png[/img]

[h2]Hangout Events 💛[/h2]
You can schedule [b]Hangout Events[/b] once you reach “Blue Hearts” with an eligible NPC. These events are friendly dates - you can [b]walk around with the townsfolk and try out different activities[/b] depending on the date location! Hangout Events are completely optional, but you can learn more about the NPCs through them. You also [b]earn more Relationship Points[/b] with them from a good date.

The first hangout location I’ve added is the Tavern: activities include listening to the jukebox, having a meal, and playing darts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/a970c98a8b67b7a552df6ea5ccfe0c3097a7c269.png[/img]

[h2]Heart Events 💖[/h2]
I absolutely [i]love[/i] Heart Events in farming sims. It’s a portion of the game I want to put a lot of care into, to share NPCs’ stories and bring a smile to players’ faces. I’m glad to say that the foundations for the Heart Events and cutscenes are done. I don’t want to spoil anything - but I’ve started to add more Heart Events into the game, which you can [b]unlock by reaching certain relationship levels[/b] with NPCs.

[h2]Zuri, the Magic Researcher! 🔮[/h2]
Another NPC-update, another NPC reveal! Meet [b]Zuri[/b], our lovely [b]magic researcher[/b] from the Violet Archive. I’ve had her design sketched for a long time, and I’m thrilled to finally add her to the game. I kind of love that she looks a little like a magical girl. On the topic of magic, some might wonder if players can cast spells in the game. I have no plans for that, and [b]magic will be explored in other ways[/b] - you’ll find out when you play the game in the future! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/b175b5f0a3e0df31d7683108262f4bb666a687a4.png[/img]

[h3]QOL changes based on demo feedback[/h3]
I’ve also started working through the some of your feedback!
[list]
[*] Trees become transparent when players walk behind them
[*] Consuming food is easier: Players no longer have to press TAB to hold one more food after each bite. The food stays in hand until the slot is empty!
[*] Creatures that were following you when entering a building will follow you again automatically when you leave.
[/list]

See you next month!
- Miki

notes.title: Devlog #8 | Fishing mechanics!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Researchers![/h2]

[h3]Moving from demo patches to developing RS for release[/h3]
This month, we have uploaded the final patches for our demo after the event, and are back on track to focus on the release build of Research Story.

[b]✨ Thank you for playing the demo![/b]
A big thank you to everyone who has tried our demo and left feedback! I’m delighted that many of you have enjoyed it. There were lots of great suggestions on improving the experience as well.

It has been patched and players are still able to experience the demo right now! If you still face issues launching the demo, do let me know – sorry for the delay!

[b] ✨ Moving forward [/b]
We’re excited to work through your feedback and continue developing RS based on our plans and vision for the game. One of the most common feedback from the demo is to have more daily activities. In particular, a [b]highly-requested feature was fishing[/b]! 🐟 That was moved up the priority list and was the bulk of my progress in March. More details below~

[h3]New location: Lakeside and Fishers’ Hut 🐠[/h3]
Added a new location in Shimmerbrook: Lakeside - where the water is green and the fisher resides.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/5bbef37677ecb86548a8a7e4b3863ef1f2e09554.gif[/img]
[i]Fishing side by side with fisher[/i]

[h3]Fishing minigame 🎣[/h3]
Players can cast their fishing rod at any water source, if they have [b]Bait[/b] in their inventory. Wait for a fish to bite, and you can start reeling the fish in! The fishing mini-game is based on [b]a reel spool and handle[/b]. To successfully reel in a fish, left click when the handle is within the marked area, and fill up the reel bar (below the circle). There are plans to add creatures (or other items) that help ease the fishing difficulty in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/1ff24563a75037a0b9880e9dd003da367f209b0c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/d7d47d9a170cea04acdbf30cc9f682ac7ce04894.gif[/img]
[i]Difficulty variations in fishing mini-game[/i]

[h3]Fish Research 🔍[/h3]
Sometimes, instead of fish, players will reel in an [b]unidentified fish part[/b], such as a fish scale. The item can be scanned using a device called the [b]Origin Tracker[/b], found in the Fishers’ Hut. After scanning the item, you will find out the types of bait the fish is attracted to, as well as seasonality and locations where you can find the fish. You can then catch the fish to complete research!

Note: Most common fish do not require research; this mechanic only applies to some unique fish!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/14b33efbc8283130542b2e14351817c362064d44.gif[/img]
[i]Origin Tracker mini-game[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/bdb231ad5959a0232c0f2cf589d7618f45f5c0e6.gif[/img]
[i]Journal records for identifying a fish part[/i]

[h3]Discord server[/h3]
We have also started a Discord server and the community is growing! Come join us if you’d like to chat with the community, ask questions, or keep up to date with the game’s progress!
[list]
[*] Join the Research Story community on Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/CRgpcpckMB]Invite link[/url] 🙌
[/list]

As usual, thank you for reading and for your awesome support so far! I’ll be focusing on NPCs in the coming weeks 💖

- Miki

notes.title: Research Story Devlog #3 | Taming and Raising Creatures!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Researchers![/b]

Last month, I shared a little about farming and plant characteristics. This month, I’d like to share some progress made on [b]creature taming and management[/b]! 🐓

[h2]Taming Creatures[/h2]

To start off, wild creatures you find in the areas surrounding Shimmerbrook can be tamed. Observe them to find out their diet, and feed them to gain their trust! [b]Creatures are either diurnal or nocturnal[/b], which affects when they can appear. Here we have a Sproutkitten appearing in the day and a Raccoon enjoying a meal at night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/178898c7a0e41b8395f691842a75cc6a56abd03c.png[/img]

[h2]Creature needs and happiness[/h2]

After taming your creatures, you’ll need to meet their basic needs by giving them a home and feeding them daily. This is where [b]Creature Pens[/b] come in, which are items that can be placed on your farm. Assign creatures to the pens, and add feed to the trough!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/e981ce0c209491006fa2b0cf4824983060b50543.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/65193f50827e92fbe15f5b2fbe62dc75f11c9d16.gif[/img]

There are also [b]pen upgrades[/b] that you can work towards to make management easier! [b]Autofeeders[/b] store a stack of feed and add to the trough automatically. [b]Music boxes[/b] help to keep creatures happy, so missing a day or two of interactions will not reduce their happiness significantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/f621684bc9b9a567c0493dc1037b0861c7eed908.gif[/img]

[h2]Creature perks[/h2]

Happy creatures bond with their owners more quickly, and after some time, these creatures [b]unlock perks[/b] and become little companions to aid you with your daily exploration and farming! Activate these perks by having the creatures follow you.

Currently, we have a few variations of perks. For example, Chickens find additional seeds from foraging; and Sproutkittens magically grow seeds into sprouts when players water their plots!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/a97dbef8a69272c5dc71686cbd96d51385183dd5.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/6f305505e302549ee286303a4ce6643958593c71.gif[/img]

[h2]Creature Research[/h2]

Going back to the theme of the game, the research process for a creature involves observing, taming, and raising them. Once those are done, you’ll complete a Creature Research Scroll, ready to be submitted to the Archive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/2922ddd99018d989f4f77314e05a0641edc871f0.gif[/img]

[h2]New interior: Rhea’s treehouse[/h2]

I’ve also started working on the interior of Rhea’s place - as a druid, she can guide you in creature taming and raising. I plan to have her sell items such as Feed and Creature Pens, and the shop has been set up in the top right corner in the treehouse. Here’s a first look at the interior:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/98804f30643b5c0a4831d629cd665ba40bfae8b4.gif[/img]

[h2]That's a wrap![/h2]

Thank you for reading to the end! Recently, we've received a lot of support for the game, particularly due to Play with Josh’s video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bwAi7lFZWxE
I’d just like to [b]welcome new folks and thank you for the continued love and support[/b]! We reached over 1k wishlists on Steam in the past week, and I’m so happy that so many of you are interested in RS - it keeps me going strong! <3 See you next month!

In the meantime, check out our [url=https://twitter.com/mikixen_]Twitter[/url] for more regular updates!

- Mikixen

notes.title: Research Story Devlog #2 | Foraging and Farming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Researchers![/h1]

In this devlog, I’ll share a bit more about how foraging and farming works in the game.

[h2]Foraging[/h2]

There are two types of drops you can get from foraging: 1) [b]Plant Research Samples[/b] (i.e. the plant itself), and 2) [b]Seeds[/b]. Seeds can only be foraged after you have observed the plants during research. When starting out, this means that instead of buying seeds, you have to find your own!

Some plants can only be found in the wild under certain conditions, so get them while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/cfccd2e781e66a71e380d41349b9f9242d200c70.gif[/img]

[h2]Farming[/h2]

There are trees, weeds, branches, and rocks scattered all around your farm. You’ll have to make space for your crops and buildings! Equip the right tools for the job from your trusty toolbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/da4902ebfab78abcdb66aa2cff9ab40f0fa4fc82.gif[/img]

With some space, you can start sowing seeds. Crop growth is affected by various conditions, including weather, distance to a water source, and sun exposure. Knowing how to care for your crops is important, else you might end up with a withered one - but that’s all part of research!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/ab9e1f347ab8b8f86722735c39b813cf23421062.gif[/img]

By foraging and successfully growing a crop, you’ll complete records for a plant research scroll, which can be added to the Archive. Vallee will be pleased!

- Mikixen

notes.title: Research Story Devlog #1 | Research mechanics!

Newly recruited as a researcher in the Violet Archive, your goal is to contribute your findings on the plants and creatures you’ll come across around Shimmerbrook. Collect samples, observe, and grow plants or raise animals - and record everything you discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40811669/0e22fe9aac8f400753eade595873402c0f45ef5d.gif[/img]
